description: Consolidate the core planning chain: /prd plans and tracks, /delegate executes from prd.json, templates share one shape, and the plan lands in a draft PR before implementation.

userStories.title: Merge /plan into /prd
userStories.description: As an operator, I want one planning skill that writes .agro/tasks/<slug>/prd.md with feat.md headings so that I review one document.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/skills/plan/ is removed
/prd keeps /plan's repository grounding and /ste pass and uses feat.md section headings
/prd holds the only slug rules
/prd offers the /git draft-PR procedure only after operator approval
prd-output-path-contract probe passes; plan-orchestration-contract probe removed or replaced
/prd triggers include "write a plan" and "plan this"
/prd's plan structure ends with a ## Lessons section that the advisor fills before undraft
userStories.notes: Accepted by advisor. EXECUTED: .agro/skills/plan and plan-orchestration-contract.sh removed (test ! -e, exit 0). EXECUTED: prd-output-path-contract failed before the rewrite (exit 1) and passes after, on the integrated branch (exit 0). EXECUTED: ste-check on prd/SKILL.md exit 0; 188 lines. EXECUTED: grep for .agro/plans, /ralph, skills/plan in the skill exit 1 (none). REASONED: grounding, BLOCKED status, and no-invented-values rules kept in sections 3 and 6; headings match feat.md in order; slug rules only here; section 7 gates tracker conversion and the /git draft PR on explicit approval; triggers include write a plan and plan this; skeleton ends with ## Lessons.

userStories.title: Fold /ralph into /prd as references/tracker.md
userStories.description: As an operator, I want prd.json conversion to be part of planning so that the tracker cannot drift from the plan.
acceptanceCriteria: .agro/skills/ralph/ is removed and .agro/skills/prd/references/tracker.md exists
branchName is always <prefix>/<issue#>-<slug>; no ralph/ prefix remains
Example includes schemaVersion; no Amp or .claude/skills/git reference remains
Optional dependsOn, files, and commit story fields are documented
Story sizing and verifiable-criteria rules exist only in tracker.md

userStories.title: Add the draft-PR-for-task procedure to /git
userStories.description: As an operator, I want the approved plan committed and a draft PR opened before implementation so that I can inspect work in progress.
acceptanceCriteria: Issue title format is <prefix>: <shortdesc>
A Draft PR for a task section covers issue, branch, plan commit, push, and draft PR from the PR template
No .claude/skills path references remain in /git
The ready step refuses undraft unless prd.md has a non-empty ## Lessons section; "None" is allowed
userStories.notes: Accepted by advisor after one repair (4e523351 then dab73eaf): the ready step first named the old PR template sections. EXECUTED: grep .claude/skills in git/SKILL.md exit 1 (none). EXECUTED: git-skill probe exit 0 on the integrated branch. EXECUTED: the Lessons awk check exits 0 on core-planning-chain/prd.md and 1 on a file without the section, an empty section, and a non-final section. REASONED: Draft PR for a task covers issue, branch, plan commit, push, and draft PR with a jq Stories checklist; issue title is <prefix>: <shortdesc>. Pre-existing ste-check findings outside the new lines are unchanged.

userStories.title: Slim /delegate to execute from prd.json
userStories.description: As an advisor session, I want /delegate to run stories from prd.json so that one file holds tasks and completion state.
acceptanceCriteria: /delegate opens with an Advisor/Worker pattern section: the advisor (active session) decides, assigns, verifies, accepts, and alone writes prd.json; a worker implements one bounded assignment and never accepts its own result
AGENTS.md glossary defines worker; no core-chain file introduces executor for this role
/delegate reads prd.json stories as tasks, using priority and optional dependsOn for waves
The active session sets passes, commit, and notes after acceptance; workers never write prd.json
Worker briefs require each criterion to be reported as executed (command and exit status) or reasoned
notes records that classification for every criterion of an accepted story
Each accepted story is committed and pushed and the PR Stories checklist is updated
delegate-graph.json, the recursion gate, /spec coupling, and all model names are removed; the dispatch record keeps at most 8 fields
Worker model defaults move to the Claude Code subagent-model setting in .claude/settings.json when that setting exists; otherwise they are dropped. Nothing is written outside the repository
The closing step writes ## Lessons in prd.md: each lesson has a claim, evidence, and exactly one outcome (fixed in this PR, issue #N, or dropped with reason)
delegate-worker-boundary and delegate-model-effort-policy probes pass

userStories.title: Align the PR and issue templates
userStories.description: As a reviewer, I want each PR to show story progress and answer the issue it closes.
acceptanceCriteria: .github/pull_request_template.md has a Stories checklist near the top
It has sections for what the issue asked for, what was built, divergence, and what remains unverified
The template names no repository-specific branch or tool
feat.md Metadata carries no worktree path; worktree placement belongs to the environment
The PR template has a Lessons section that summarizes prd.md ## Lessons
userStories.notes: Accepted by advisor. EXECUTED: grep '^## ' shows Stories first (line 13), then What the issue asked for, What was built, Where it diverged, What remains unverified, Verification, Visual Reference, Lessons, Checklist (exit 0). EXECUTED: grep -i 'development|pnpm|jq|agro|worktree' on the PR template exit 1 (no match). EXECUTED: grep -c worktree feat.md = 0. REASONED: feat.md line 11 'development workflow' is an English adjective, not a branch name; left unchanged. No consumer depends on the removed Summary/Changes/Test Plan/Out of Scope sections (grep of .agro, .github/workflows).

userStories.title: Track the core task contract in git
userStories.description: As an operator, I want prd.md and prd.json committed without force-adds so that the draft PR carries the plan and its evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: git check-ignore does not match .agro/tasks/<slug>/prd.md or prd.json
The duplicate .agro/tasks ignore block is removed
.agro/tasks/AGENTS.md describes the two-file core contract, marks progress.txt as /spec-only, and drops delegate-graph.json
task-completion-structured-state and spec-task-artifact-contract probes pass
userStories.notes: Accepted by advisor. EXECUTED: git check-ignore --no-index on .agro/tasks/<slug>/prd.md and prd.json exit 1 (not ignored); progress.txt and archive/<date>/<slug>/prd.md exit 0 (ignored). EXECUTED: one .agro/tasks/* block remains. EXECUTED: task-completion-structured-state and spec-task-artifact-contract exit 0 on the integrated branch. EXECUTED: git status shows 0 newly visible task files (existing ones were already force-added). REASONED: tasks/AGENTS.md states the two-file contract, advisor-only prd.json writes, executed/reasoned notes, /spec-only progress.txt, and drops delegate-graph.json.

userStories.title: Repoint references and verify
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want no live reference to removed skills so that the chain works end to end without new probe machinery.
acceptanceCriteria: A one-time grep finds no live reference to skills/plan, skills/ralph, .agro/plans, or a ralph/ branch prefix outside archives
Probes that check deleted skills are removed or updated; no new probe is added
/spec, /supervisor, /retro, /audit, and crons reference /prd and prd/references/tracker.md where they referenced /plan or /ralph
/spec plan can still add its Knowledge Context and Plan Reconciliation sections to /prd output
Provider skill symlinks resolve
/eval reports no REGRESSION against the pre-change baseline
CHANGELOG has an [Unreleased] entry
